payload.text:
Fixed both off-by-one errors in [src/pagination.js](/private/var/folders/wz/1j18wyv50vb_g1hlhd5zz_yw0000gn/T/workforce-r0/state-human/workspaces/01a07ade-6f69-7166-89b2-650940cddd7a/01a07ade-6f69-7167-841f-caf42f889fe3/01a07ade-6f69-7168-8ac6-7ab3af6c4d09/src/pagination.js:8):

- `pageCount()` now uses `Math.ceil`, preserving partial final pages.
- `paginate()` now uses the correct exclusive slice endpoint.

Evidence: `node --test test/` passes all 5 tests with 0 failures. `git diff --check` also passes. No commits or Git administration changes were made.
